tei:titleStmt.tei:title: תְּפִלָּה קֹדֶם קַבָּלַת תְּרוּמַת אֵיבָרִים
Prayer for a Multiple Organ Transplant Recipient, by Dr. Yael Levine

tei:div.tei:head: Prayer for a Multiple Organ Transplant Recipient, by Dr. Yael Levine

tei:lg.tei:l: “The lovingkindness of the Lord does not cease,
His compassion is endless” (Lamentations 3:23)
Master of the Universe,
I stand now before You
in fear and love,
with great trepidation of Your Holiness,
and with immense gratitude,
as I am about to undergo organ transplantation.
I lift up my eyes to the heavens,
and beseech You to have mercy and bestow Your blessings upon me
so that the transplants will succeed.
May my body accept the transplanted organs,
and never reject them.
May I merit to have a complete recovery,
to regain my health,
and live a long life in good health,
peace and prosperity.
Grant success to the physicians
and medical team
who are scheduled to carry out the transplant on me.
I am overflowing with gratitude from the core of my being
for the great lovingkindness that is being bestowed upon me,
that the organs of the deceased are being donated following their passing.
May the merit of this deed endure
and accompany the ascension of their soul.
I thank from the bottom of my heart the family members of the departed,
who are engaged in the donation process
and making it a reality.
He who heals the brokenhearted,
please strengthen them following the loss of their beloved.
May they be granted all the blessings mentioned and written in the Torah,
for You are God who hears prayers and supplications.
Blessed are You, who hears prayers.
